_meta.trust_law: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA); Strata Titles (General) Regulations 2019

max_interest_rate_pa.legislation: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA); scheme by-laws dependent
max_interest_rate_pa.notes: Operational ceiling placeholder pending scheme-law review; production levy interest must use the scheme-approved rule.

trial_balance_deadline_days.legislation: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA); manager contract dependent
trial_balance_deadline_days.notes: Operational default for managed schemes; confirm against manager contract and applicable licensing obligations.

min_withholding_pct_no_abn.notes: ATO PAYG withholding: 47% on payments to suppliers without ABN.

agm_notice_days.notes: General meeting notice must be given to owners and first mortgagees.

capital_funding_standard_notice_days.legislation: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA) s.129; Landgate strata guidance
capital_funding_standard_notice_days.notes: No verified generic capital-funding levy payment period is encoded. WA guidance ties contribution approval to meeting notice and unit entitlement/by-law controls.

capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.notes: No shorter generic emergency period is encoded.

capital_funding_notice_period_verified.notes: Payment-period validation must rely on legal-review evidence, registered by-laws and approved motion text, not a generic platform default.

capital_funding_resolution_required.notes: Contribution approvals must follow the strata company meeting and by-law framework.

capital_funding_allocation_basis.legislation: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA) s.37; Landgate unit entitlement guidance
capital_funding_allocation_basis.notes: Unit entitlement determines levy contributions, subject to scheme by-laws.

capital_funding_benefit_principle_availa.notes: No generic benefit-principle allocator is enabled; mixed-use by-law allocation needs legal review.

capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.notes: Tenant consultation is not a default contribution-approval condition.

capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.notes: No WA-specific hardship notice requirement is encoded; hardship workflows should remain available by policy.

capital_funding_hybrid_legal_review_requ.notes: Hybrid owner-funded and loan-funded structures require recorded legal approval before notices or credits are issued.
